correctness.rationale: For every compact full-dimensional planar convex polygon, exposing one edge of (1+lambda)P shows that the two endpoint copies leave a gap when lambda<1. Center P at a Minkowski center, -P subset sP. The sets (v+sP)/(1+s) contain the center; their respective portions of each edge have fraction s/(s+1)>=1/2, so they cover all boundary edges. Convexity and radial segments from the center fill all of P, proving c_V<=s<=2. For the centered regular even n-gon s=1; for odd n, s=sec(pi/n), and the origin is not in V+lambda P below that value, proving sharpness. Full domain, affine invariance and n=3 case are accounted for. This is an infinite geometric argument, not an enumeration.

evidence: Existing universal planar vertex-generation bound c_V<=2 follows s<=2, but the new comparison retains each P-specific s.
